subject.title: feat: discover OpenCode and Pi sessions on paired nodes

question: Should these bundled catalogs ship enabled by default with the shared Gateway behavior that lets trusted plugin node calls replace a narrower request client with their declared synthetic scopes?
rationale: The feature needs paired-node invocation, but the patch combines a product default decision with a generic authorization-boundary expansion that cannot be accepted solely from implementation and CI evidence.

options.title: Approve with constrained proof
options.body: Ship the catalogs default-on after confirming only trusted owner-validated plugins can use synthetic scope replacement and adding focused sibling-boundary coverage.

options.title: Make catalogs opt-in
options.body: Preserve the plugin-owned implementation but require explicit configuration and avoid changing generic scope behavior until a narrower node-read contract exists.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a permanent generic authorization and upstream compatibility contract for external session catalogs.

recommendation.title: Approve with constrained proof
recommendation.body: Ship the catalogs default-on after confirming only trusted owner-validated plugins can use synthetic scope replacement and adding focused sibling-boundary coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository history most directly connects this person to the session architecture, bundled runtime integration, and affected Gateway boundary.
